title: int:IdentityCredential
description: W3C Verifiable Credential issued to a DID for EWDS role-based access control.

credentialId.description: Primary identifier. IRI: int:credentialId. UUID v4.

roleNamespace.description: Dot-separated lower-case alphanumeric credential namespace. IRI: int:credentialNamespace.

role.description: Credential type issued to the EWDS Client Gateway user. IRI: int:credentialType.

issuedTo.description: DID the credential is issued to. IRI: int:issuedTo. W3C DID format.

issuedBy.description: DID of the credential issuer. IRI: int:issuedBy. W3C DID format.

validFrom.description: Start of credential validity. IRI: int:validFrom. ISO 8601 with timezone.

validUntil.description: End of credential validity. NULL if no expiry. IRI: int:validUntil.
